description: This file defines internal utility components for handling function references and invocations within the Abseil C++ library, including type traits, a union for function pointers, and invocation helpers.

classes.name: VoidPtr
classes.description: A union that can hold either a const void pointer or a function pointer, used for type erasure in function invocation.

classes.name: PassByValue
classes.description: Type trait to determine if a type should be passed by value based on trivial copy and size characteristics.

classes.name: ForwardT
classes.description: Type trait to decide whether to pass a type by value or rvalue reference.

methods.name: InvokeObject
methods.description: Invokes a callable object of type Obj with provided arguments.

methods.name: InvokeFunction
methods.description: Invokes a function pointer with provided arguments.

methods.name: AssertNonNull
methods.description: Checks that a std::function or pointer is not null.
